en.headline: Two mainland men jailed 10 months for 190,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes at airport
en.dek: Customs seized the cigarettes, with a market value of about HK$850,000, from the personal baggage of passengers arriving from Vientiane via Hanoi; the sentences were handed down at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts.
body: Two mainland Chinese men were each sentenced to 10 months’ imprisonment by the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday for dealing with duty-not-paid cigarettes, the Customs and Excise Department said.

The men, aged 48 and 39, were arrested at Hong Kong International Airport on Tuesday after arriving on a flight from Vientiane, Laos, via Hanoi, Vietnam. Officers found a total of about 190,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes in their personal baggage. The consignment had an estimated market value of about HK$850,000 and a duty potential of about HK$627,000.

Customs welcomed the sentences, saying the custodial terms imposed a considerable deterrent effect and reflected the seriousness of the offences. Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, anyone involved in importing, dealing with, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes commits an offence punishable by a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 兩內地男攜19萬支未完稅香煙抵港 同判囚10個月
zh.dek: 海關在機場兩名由老撾經河內抵港旅客的個人行李檢獲合共約19萬支未完稅香煙，市值約85萬元；西九龍裁判法院周三判處各人監禁10個月。
body: 兩名內地男旅客因處理未完稅香煙，違反《應課稅品條例》，周三在西九龍裁判法院各被判處監禁10個月。
海關人員周二在香港國際機場先後拘捕兩名分別48歲及39歲的內地男子，兩人均由老撾萬象出發、經越南河內飛抵本港。關員在他們隨身行李內搜出合共約19萬支未完稅香煙，估計市值約85萬元，應課稅值約62.7萬元。
海關歡迎裁決，指監禁刑罰具相當阻嚇作用，並充分反映罪行的嚴重性。根據《應課稅品條例》，任何人進口、處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙即屬違法，一經定罪最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
